targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.module_a_temp) AS "inv/module_a_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.module_b_temp) AS "inv/module_b_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.module_c_temp) AS "inv/module_c_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.gate_driver_temp) AS "inv/gate_driver_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.coolant_temp) AS "inv/coolant_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.inverter_hotspot_temp) AS "inv/inverter_hotspot_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_temp) AS "inv/motor_temp [C]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(pack.phase_a_current) AS "inv/phase_a_current [A]", AVG(pack.phase_b_current) AS "inv/phase_b_current [A]", AVG(pack.phase_c_current) AS "inv/phase_c_current [A]", AVG(pack.dc_bus_current) AS "inv/dc_bus_current [A]", AVG(pack.dc_bus_v) AS "inv/dc_bus_v [V]", AVG(pack.neutral_output_v) AS "inv/neutral_output_v [V]", AVG(pack.vab_vq_v) AS "inv/vab_vq_v [V]", AVG(pack.vbc_vd_v) AS "inv/vbc_vd_v [V]", AVG(pack.bus_voltage) AS "inv/bus_voltage [V]" FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(controls.motor_speed) AS "inv/motor_speed [rpm]", AVG(controls.rpm_request) AS "vcu/rpm_request [rpm]", AVG(controls.motor_angle) AS "inv/motor_angle [deg]", AVG(pack.delta_resolver_angle) AS "inv/delta_resolver_angle [deg]", AVG(pack.inverter_freq) AS "inv/inverter_freq [Hz]", AVG(pack.time_since_on) AS "inv/time_since_on [s]", AVG(controls.commanded_torque) AS "inv/commanded_torque [Nm]", AVG(controls.torque_feedback) AS "inv/torque_feedback [Nm]", AVG(controls.torque_command) AS "inv/torque_command [Nm]", AVG(controls.torque_shudder) AS "inv/torque_shudder [Nm]", AVG(controls.torque_request) AS "vcu/torque_request [Nm]", AVG(controls.torque_limit) AS "vcu/torque_limit [Nm]", AVG(CASE WHEN controls.enable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "vcu/enable [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN controls.direction THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "vcu/direction [bool]", AVG(diagnostics_high.post_faults) AS "inv/post_faults [uint32]", AVG(diagnostics_high.run_faults) AS "inv/run_faults [uint32]" FROM controls JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN pack ON pack.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN diagnostics_high ON diagnostics_high.packet_id = controls.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
